title: Google Adds Agentic Video Understanding Across Gemini Models
dek: Google says its latest Gemini models can now use an agentic approach to video analysis, aimed at improving accuracy while reducing token consumption and cost.
socialCaption: Google is bringing agentic video understanding to its latest Gemini models, saying it can improve video-analysis accuracy while cutting token usage and cost. The business test will be whether those gains hold up on real, long-form video workflows.
